blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current front, back and three-quarter renders: the jacket still reads mainly as plain ivory with a broad flat diagonal lavender band and sparse buttons; tailored seam detailing and clear rear finishing remain absent.
Direct inspection of arms-up and arm-cross: the lavender elbow diamonds remain oversized, with angular and corrugated folds around the shoulders, underarms and sleeves.

The bilateral center-hem weight trial measurably raises upper-thigh ray coverage to crouch 0.5797/0.5740 and sit 0.4599/0.4814 (left/right), from 0.4384/0.426 and 0.3424/0.3322 in the prior projection trial. Direct inspection still shows uncovered shorts and large rigid triangular side flaps in crouch and sit; the skirt also hangs near the knees while standing. Improvement is measured, but exposure and side flares remain a visual blocker; prototype metrics grant no fit acceptance.
Direct inspection of prone: the garment remains collapsed into a stiff, irregular fan with distorted sleeve and skirt surfaces; the bilateral center-hem weighting does not resolve the drape defect.

Direct inspection of left and right side renders: skirt folds remain faceted and the waist-to-skirt transition is abrupt. The front projection is removed, but crouch and sit still produce large angular side flaps rather than a sewn-looking moving contour.
Direct inspection of back: the rear remains largely featureless ivory without clear rear finishing or waist-adjustment detail.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
